headline: Dell signed an MoU with Aramco Digital covering industrial AI, AI infrastructure, managed IT, cyber resilience and joint go-to-market through Dell channel partners. A Hassan Allam and Sterling & Wilson JV won an estimated SR750m contract to build phase 1 of the HUMAIN–center3 Riyadh AI data centre (16.2 MW rising to 50 MW), with the IT fit-out still unassigned. Houthi attacks reached Riyadh's airport and an Aramco facility at Khurais, and Riyadh condemned the campaign. TrendForce forecasts Q4 contract prices up 10–15% for DRAM and 15–20% for NAND, and Micron now sees supply tightening through FY2028.
lenovo_read: Dell is taking two Lenovo positions at once: the Aramco account and the resilience story. Lenovo should answer at Aramco Digital this week with an ALAT-made, Neptune-cooled industrial-AI and continuity offer, and bid for the center3/HUMAIN 50 MW IT package while the halls are still at MEP design stage.

pillars.dc: 2 scored: HUMAIN–center3 Riyadh construction award (16.2 MW to 50 MW, IT undisclosed) and S&P's GCC data-centre outlook. MIS Work Order No. 2 was published before the window and is rejected.
pillars.memory: 4 scored: Nanya and TrendForce Q4 forecast (DRAM +10–15%, NAND +15–20%), Micron tighter through FY28, HBM4 near-tripling in 2027, flat panels as component costs rise. Spot DDR5 16Gb $58.167 (6 Oct).
pillars.deals: Dell–Aramco Digital, HUMAIN–center3 builder award, Salam–Nutanix, Dell–CPX–UAE CSC, OpenAI–UAE funds talks, eFinance–Alibaba Cloud. No META build names a server or storage OEM.
pillars.global: Dell, Nutanix, AMD, Mistral and NAVER in META. Chinese rule: Alibaba Cloud, Tencent (DeepSeek), Huawei (Qualcomm licence).

stories.title: Dell Technologies and Aramco Digital sign MoU to advance Industrial AI and Digital Infrastructure across Saudi Arabia
stories.published: 5 Oct 2026, first copies 14:01–14:07 KSA (Google News RSS)
stories.summary: Dell and Aramco Digital signed an exploratory MoU covering industrial AI, multi-cloud, data protection and secure AI, plus joint go-to-market through Dell's authorised channel partners. No value or deployment was disclosed.
bullets: The MoU was signed by Mohamed Talaat, Vice President, Saudi, Egypt, North Africa & Levant (SENAL), Dell Technologies, and Dr. Ashraf Al-Tahini, Chief Executive Officer of Aramco Digital
The collaboration will explore opportunities to improve operational efficiency, optimise multi-cloud environments, strengthen data protection and deploy secure and scalable Industrial AI solutions
The agreement will explore joint go-to-market initiatives and expand access to Dell Technologies' enterprise solutions across the Kingdom through authorised channel partners
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG/IDG: Dell is now Aramco Digital's named industrial-AI infrastructure partner, and the go-to-market clause could make Aramco Digital a Dell route to market. Counter this week with ALAT local manufacturing, Neptune, ThinkEdge and TruScale.
stories.arabic: دل تكنولوجيز وأرامكو الرقمية توقعان مذكرة تفاهم لاستكشاف حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي الصناعي والبنية التحتية الرقمية والأمن السيبراني، مع مبادرات تسويق مشتركة عبر الشركاء المعتمدين في المملكة.

stories.title: Joint venture wins Riyadh data centre construction deal
stories.summary: Hassan Allam Construction and Sterling & Wilson won an estimated SR750m contract for phase 1 (16.2 MW, 16 months) of the HUMAIN–center3 Riyadh data centre, which rises to 50 MW with four 11.2 MW high-density halls. Construction scope only.
bullets: Hassan Allam Construction and Sterling & Wilson won an estimated SR750m ($200m) contract for the first phase of a Riyadh data centre developed by Humain and Center3
The first phase has 16.2MW of IT load and is scheduled for 16 months, with the second phase taking overall capacity to 50MW
On completion the facility will include one 5MW standard-density hall and four high-density halls, each rated at 11.2MW
stories.lenovo: ISG: IT hardware undisclosed, an open ISG opportunity. The 11.2 MW high-density halls suit liquid-cooled GPU racks; engage center3, HUMAIN procurement and the JV's MEP designers on Neptune now. Updates OPP-036/055.
stories.arabic: تحالف حسن علام وستيرلنغ آند ويلسون يفوز بعقد تقديري بقيمة 750 مليون ريال لبناء المرحلة الأولى من مركز بيانات هيوماين وسنتر3 في الرياض بسعة 16.2 ميغاواط ترتفع إلى 50 ميغاواط.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Strongly Condemns Houthi Militia's Continued Targeting of Civilians and Civilian and Economic Facilities
stories.summary: The Foreign Ministry condemned Houthi attacks on Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and other cities and on Saudi ships, and reaffirmed the right to self-defence. Aramco is not named.
bullets: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs condemned Houthi attacks on Makkah, Madinah, the capital Riyadh, and the cities of Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan, Najran, Taif and Yanbu
The statement also condemned the targeting of Saudi vessels in the southern Red Sea and the Bab al-Mandab Strait
The Kingdom reaffirmed its inherent right to defend its territory, resources, sovereignty and the safety of its citizens and residents
stories.lenovo: All BUs: the threat now reaches Riyadh aviation and Eastern Province energy sites. Review RHQ duty of care and ALAT continuity daily; resilience and DR are now explicit customer requirements (OPP-061).
stories.arabic: المملكة تدين بشدة استمرار استهداف الحوثيين للمدنيين والمنشآت المدنية والاقتصادية، فيما أعلن الحوثيون استهداف مطار الملك خالد ومقتل عامل بنغلاديشي في هجوم على منشأة لأرامكو في خريص.

stories.title: Houthis strike Riyadh airport, declare Saudi airspace open target
stories.summary: The Houthis say they struck King Khalid International Airport on 5 Oct and declared Saudi skies an open theatre except Makkah and Madinah. A Bangladeshi worker was killed in an attack on an Aramco facility.
bullets: The Houthi military spokesperson said the group targeted King Khaled Airport in Riyadh on October 5, claiming the strike disrupted air traffic
The Houthis declared Saudi skies an open theatre for their operations, except the holy airspaces of Makkah and Madinah
The report links the attack to damage to Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline and a Bangladeshi worker killed in a Houthi attack on a Saudi Aramco facility
stories.lenovo: All BUs: companion to the SPA statement. These are Houthi claims; Saudi authorities have not confirmed damage. Same continuity and resilience implications (OPP-061).
stories.arabic: الحوثيون يعلنون استهداف مطار الملك خالد في الرياض واعتبار الأجواء السعودية مسرحًا مفتوحًا لعملياتهم باستثناء أجواء مكة والمدينة.

stories.title: Salam and Nutanix Partner to Deliver Private Cloud Services to Saudi Enterprises
stories.published: 5 Oct 2026, first copy 18:01 KSA (Menafn RSS); signed at LEAP 2026
stories.summary: Salam and Nutanix set up a three-year managed-service partnership for Private Cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service to Saudi B2B customers. The MoU was signed at LEAP 2026 and first published in the window.
bullets: Etihad Salam Telecom Company and Nutanix established a three-year managed service partnership to deliver Private Cloud Infrastructure as a Service to Saudi enterprises
The partnership targets B2B customers across Saudi Arabia, with Abdullah Khorami, Chief Business Officer at Salam, and Talal Al-Saif, Regional Director for Saudi Arabia at Nutanix
The Memorandum of Understanding was signed at LEAP 2026, where Salam participated as a strategic sponsor
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: Lenovo ThinkAgile HX is Nutanix-certified, a direct way to get Lenovo hardware under Salam's private cloud. Salam already partners Dell (OPP-004).
stories.arabic: سلام ونوتانكس توقعان شراكة لخدمات مُدارة لثلاث سنوات لتقديم البنية التحتية السحابية الخاصة كخدمة لعملاء قطاع الأعمال في المملكة.

stories.title: UAE, Saudi Arabia to be biggest drivers of data centre growth in Middle East: S&P
stories.summary: S&P expects Middle East data-centre capacity to triple by 2030, with the UAE and KSA adding about 2–3 GW of IT power. Build costs are about $13m/MW in KSA and $11m/MW in the UAE (forecasts).
bullets: Middle East data centre capacity will triple by 2030, with the UAE and Saudi Arabia adding about 2 GW to 3 GW of IT power and more than 80 percent of the regional share
HUMAIN's Saudi projects will reach 1.9 GW by 2030, rising to 6-6.6 GW in 2034, while the 5 GW UAE-US AI Campus will deliver its initial 1 GW within three years
Construction costs average $13 million per megawatt in Saudi Arabia and $11 million/MW in the UAE over 2026-2030
stories.lenovo: ISG: analyst sizing for the management narrative. S&P names telcos (stc/center3, e&, Ooredoo) as the main growth driver, so they remain ISG's priority channel.
stories.arabic: ستاندرد آند بورز: الإمارات والسعودية تقودان نمو مراكز البيانات في الشرق الأوسط بإضافة 2 إلى 3 غيغاواط بحلول 2030، وتكلفة بناء الميغاواط في المملكة نحو 13 مليون دولار.

stories.title: War disruption drives Saudi giga-projects to source locally
stories.summary: ROSHN now sources about 60% of its supplies locally and is splitting contracts into smaller packages. Qiddiya and Mace Consult describe more local sourcing after Hormuz-driven import costs.
bullets: Roshn now sources about 60 percent of its supplies locally, according to chief projects delivery officer Roger Fatovic
Roshn is building about 55,000 homes in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam and is breaking work into smaller contracts so more local companies can bid
Qiddiya and Mace Consult executives said local sourcing has increased as disruption around the Strait of Hormuz drove up import costs
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: local content now drives giga-project procurement, which favours ALAT-made devices and local integrators. Links OPP-041.
stories.arabic: اضطرابات الحرب تدفع المشاريع الكبرى السعودية إلى التوريد المحلي، وروشن تؤمّن نحو 60% من احتياجاتها محليًا وتقسّم العقود لإتاحة المنافسة للشركات المحلية.

stories.title: Korea, Saudi Arabia to Widen Cooperation Beyond Energy Into AI
stories.summary: FKI and PIF co-hosted the Korea-Saudi Business Investment Forum in Seoul. NAVER Cloud presented sovereign AI, digital twin, data-centre and cloud services for Saudi Arabia.
bullets: The 2026 Korea-Saudi Business Investment Forum was co-hosted by the Federation of Korean Industries and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund in Seoul on October 6, with about 280 attendees
FKI vice chairman Kim Chang-beom said the countries should expand cooperation into AI, future mobility and bio, as well as energy, advanced manufacturing and digital infrastructure
NAVER Cloud introduced its sovereign AI business and services including digital twins, data centers and cloud services for Saudi Arabia
stories.lenovo: ISG: NAVER Cloud is a sovereign-AI platform entrant in KSA, both a competitor on platforms and a possible infrastructure buyer for any in-Kingdom region.
stories.arabic: منتدى الأعمال والاستثمار السعودي الكوري بتنظيم صندوق الاستثمارات العامة واتحاد الصناعات الكوري يوسّع التعاون إلى الذكاء الاصطناعي والبنية الرقمية، ونافر كلاود تعرض خدمات الذكاء الاصطناعي السيادي.

stories.title: China doubles down on Gulf tech as US forces AI chip choice
stories.published: 6 Oct 2026 (date only; before 09:59 KSA per Google Alert)
stories.summary: Chinese investment in the Gulf is rising while Washington ties advanced AI chip access to removing Chinese technology from core networks. G42 removed $150m of Huawei equipment.
bullets: Chinese direct investment in the United Arab Emirates exceeded $12 billion in 2025, with Saudi Arabia the second-largest destination for Chinese capital in MENA
Washington ties access to advanced AI chips to Gulf nations first eliminating Chinese technology from their core networks
G42 tore out $150 million worth of Huawei equipment after Microsoft's $1.5 billion investment in 2024
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: this is the policy frame Lenovo, as a Chinese-headquartered vendor, is judged under. Lenovo needs a crisp US-compliance and supply-chain-transparency brief for G42- and HUMAIN-class buyers (OPP-048).
stories.arabic: الصين تعزز حضورها التقني في الخليج مع اشتراط واشنطن إزالة التقنيات الصينية من الشبكات الأساسية مقابل الوصول إلى رقائق الذكاء الاصطناعي المتقدمة.

stories.title: OpenAI in talks with UAE funds, BlackRock for US$30b funding round, Bloomberg reports
stories.summary: OpenAI seeks at least $30bn at about $1.4tn pre-money valuation. MGX and other Gulf funds are discussing up to $10bn combined, and BlackRock is in talks. Talks only.
bullets: OpenAI is seeking to raise at least US$30 billion at an expected pre-money valuation of roughly US$1.4 trillion
Gulf-based funds including Abu Dhabi-based MGX are discussing a consortium to contribute as much as US$10 billion in aggregate, and BlackRock is also in talks
OpenAI most recently raised US$122 billion in March at a US$852 billion post-money valuation
stories.lenovo: ISG: UAE capital deepens OpenAI's compute build-out, reinforcing Stargate UAE as a GPU-dense destination. Campus hardware is undisclosed; watch MGX-linked procurement (OPP-025).
stories.arabic: أوبن إيه آي تجري محادثات مع صناديق إماراتية بينها MGX وبلاك روك لجولة تمويل لا تقل عن 30 مليار دولار بتقييم يقارب 1.4 تريليون دولار.

stories.title: Dell Technologies, CPX and UAE Cyber Security Council collaborate on National Vault initiative
stories.summary: Dell, CPX and the UAE Cyber Security Council launched a National Vault for critical operational data across government, energy, healthcare and transport, announced at Ai Everything 2026.
bullets: The National Vault adds a layer of protection for critical operational data across government services, energy, healthcare, transportation and other significant sectors
H.E. Dr Mohamed Al Kuwaiti, Head of Cyber Security for the UAE Government, said the initiative addresses a critical part of the resilience equation
The initiative was announced at AI Everything 2026, with Walid Yehia, Managing Director South Gulf at Dell Technologies, and CPX CEO Hadi Anwar
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: Dell's second resilience win in two days, and its first with a national-level reference. Lenovo needs an immutable-storage and DR reference before a KSA equivalent (NCA/NIC) goes out to tender.
stories.arabic: دل تكنولوجيز وسي بي إكس ومجلس الأمن السيبراني الإماراتي تتعاون في مبادرة "الخزنة الوطنية" لحماية البيانات التشغيلية الحرجة في القطاعات الحيوية.

stories.title: Etisalat to expand global connectivity capacity 25-fold by 2030
stories.published: 6 Oct 2026 11:10 KSA (page); first copy Sharjah24 5 Oct 20:20 KSA
stories.summary: e&, rebranded back to Etisalat, plans to lift international connectivity from about 20 Tbps to more than 500 Tbps by 2030 for AI and cloud demand. No investment value was disclosed.
bullets: Etisalat plans to increase international connectivity capacity to more than 500 terabits per second by 2030, from around 20Tbps today
The project aims to support rapidly growing demand for artificial intelligence and cloud computing
Etisalat group operates across 38 countries, serves more than 250 million subscribers and unveiled a vision to become an AI-powered and AI-enabling telecommunications company
stories.lenovo: ISG: connectivity at this scale is built to attract hyperscale and AI-campus tenants across e&'s 38 countries. Pitch an AI-telco infrastructure stack (OPP-014).
stories.arabic: اتصالات تعتزم رفع سعة الربط الدولي من نحو 20 إلى أكثر من 500 تيرابت في الثانية بحلول 2030 لدعم الطلب على الذكاء الاصطناعي والحوسبة السحابية.

stories.title: eFinance and Alibaba Cloud Collaborate to Provide World-Class Cloud Computing Services Through Infrastructure Hosted in Egypt
stories.summary: eFinance, Alibaba Cloud and Nuvexa signed an MoU to offer Alibaba Cloud services on infrastructure hosted in Egypt, starting with SMEs, agriculture and digital commerce. Also included under the Chinese rule (Alibaba).
bullets: eFinance Investment Group, Alibaba Cloud and Nuvexa signed a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding to expand access to cloud services within Egypt
The MoU was signed on October 4, 2026, in Cairo on the sidelines of the Apsara Conference
The initial focus is small and medium-sized enterprises, the agricultural sector and digital commerce, with data hosted locally in Egypt
stories.lenovo: ISG: a Chinese cloud stack is localising through an Egyptian state-linked operator and competing for sovereign-hosting demand. Local hardware is undisclosed (links OPP-034).
stories.arabic: إي فاينانس وعلي بابا كلاود ونوفيكسا توقع مذكرة تفاهم لتقديم خدمات الحوسبة السحابية عبر بنية مستضافة في مصر مع إبقاء البيانات داخل البلاد.

stories.title: Mistral CEO says new AI model beats Chinese ones in some areas
stories.summary: Arthur Mensch unveiled Mistral's new model at Ai Everything Abu Dhabi, claimed it beats Chinese models on cybersecurity, and pitched Mistral as an alternative supplier for the Gulf.
bullets: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch announced the company's newest AI model at the AI Everything conference in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday
Mensch said the model outperforms Chinese models on cybersecurity, without detailing which competitors or metrics
Mistral raised 3 billion euros at a 21 billion euro valuation in September
stories.lenovo: ISG: Mistral's sovereign pitch to Gulf governments creates on-premises inference demand. Co-sell Mistral-ready inference platforms (OPP-047 precedent).
stories.arabic: الرئيس التنفيذي لميسترال يكشف في أبوظبي عن نموذج جديد يتفوق على النماذج الصينية في الأمن السيبراني، ويطرح الشركة بديلاً تقنيًا مستقلاً لدول الخليج.

stories.title: AMD plans to substantially increase supply in 2027, CEO says
stories.summary: Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase supply in 2027, needs more advanced wafer capacity, and is securing memory from Samsung and SK hynix.
bullets: CEO Lisa Su said AMD is going to substantially increase its supply in 2027 and needs more advanced wafer capacity
AMD is meeting Foxconn and TSMC, and Su plans visits to South Korea to secure memory supplies from Samsung and SK Hynix
AMD is planning three to five years ahead, and its market value recently exceeded $1 trillion
stories.lenovo: ISG: more AMD supply in 2027 strengthens AMD-based AI factories (HUMAIN–AMD, OPP-042). Lock Lenovo's AMD allocation for the 2027 META pipeline now.
stories.arabic: الرئيسة التنفيذية لإيه إم دي: الشركة ستزيد إمداداتها بشكل كبير في 2027 وتحتاج مزيدًا من طاقة الرقائق المتقدمة، مع مساعٍ لتأمين الذاكرة من سامسونج وإس كيه هاينكس.

stories.title: DeepSeek set to raise at least $12 bln in Tencent, CATL-led round- Bloomberg
stories.summary: DeepSeek is raising at least CNY 80bn (about $12bn) backed by Tencent and CATL, up from a CNY 50bn target. Included under the Chinese rule (Tencent).
bullets: DeepSeek is raising at least 80 billion yuan ($12 billion) in a round backed by Tencent and CATL, with potential to reach 100 billion yuan
The company had initially sought 50 billion yuan
Earlier reports valued DeepSeek at approximately $74 billion
stories.lenovo: ISG: a better-funded DeepSeek accelerates the Huawei Ascend and DeepSeek sovereign-AI pitch in META (OPP-048). It also creates on-premises inference demand Lenovo can serve.
stories.arabic: ديب سيك تجمع ما لا يقل عن 80 مليار يوان (نحو 12 مليار دولار) في جولة تمويل بدعم من تينسنت وCATL.

stories.title: Huawei, Qualcomm agree to broad patent license deal
stories.summary: A multi-year Huawei–Qualcomm cross-licence covering 5G, compute, AI and networking; Qualcomm buys certain Huawei US patents. It needs regulatory approval. Included under the Chinese rule (Huawei).
bullets: Huawei and Qualcomm announced a multi-year patent licensing agreement covering 5G, compute, AI and networking
The deal includes cross-licenses and Qualcomm's purchase of certain Huawei U.S. patents in compute, AI, networking and related fields
The transaction requires regulatory approval before closing
stories.lenovo: IDG: Huawei is now monetising its IP even with a US chipmaker. Watch 5G and AI patent royalty exposure for Lenovo and Motorola devices.
stories.arabic: هواوي وكوالكوم توقعان اتفاقية ترخيص براءات متعددة السنوات تشمل الجيل الخامس والحوسبة والذكاء الاصطناعي، مع شراء كوالكوم براءات أمريكية من هواوي.

stories.title: [News] Nanya DRAM ASP Seen Rising 10% in 4Q26; Winbond Also Sees Further Price Gains as Memory Supply Stays Tight
stories.summary: Nanya expects DRAM ASP to rise another 10% QoQ in Q4 and meets only 50–60% of demand. TrendForce forecasts Q4 contract prices up 10–15% for DRAM and 15–20% for NAND.
bullets: Nanya's Q3 2026 revenue reached NT$133.65 billion, up 61.9% QoQ, and its DRAM ASP is expected to rise another 10% QoQ in the fourth quarter
Nanya is meeting only around 50% to 60% of customer demand, and Winbond expects memory prices to rise another 8% to 13% QoQ in Q4
Conventional DRAM contract prices are forecast to rise 10% to 15% QoQ in 4Q26 and NAND Flash contract prices 15% to 20%
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: another double-digit quarter (forecast). Every META quote running into Q4 needs memory indexation, and there is allocation risk on commodity DRAM. Update OPP-045.
stories.arabic: تريندفورس: توقع ارتفاع متوسط أسعار ذاكرة نانيا بنحو 10% في الربع الرابع، وعقود DRAM التقليدية بين 10% و15% وNAND بين 15% و20%.

stories.title: [News] Micron Sees Tighter Memory Supply Through FY28: When Will the Big Three's New Capacity Arrive?
stories.summary: Micron's CEO says supply could tighten further in FY2027–28. Major new capacity arrives in 2H28, and SK hynix's CEO warns the shortage could last to 2030.
bullets: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said memory and storage supply-demand conditions could tighten further in fiscal 2027 and 2028 versus 2026
Micron's most significant additions, including the Singapore NAND fab, Idaho ID2 and a Japan DRAM expansion, are slated for 2H28
SK hynix CEO Kwak Noh-jung warned shortages could persist through 2030, while Samsung moved Pyeongtaek P5 Phase 1 tool installation forward to 2Q27
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: tightness lasts through the FY27/28 planning horizon. Multi-year META deals need memory pass-through, and secured allocation becomes a selling point in its own right.
stories.arabic: مايكرون تتوقع مزيدًا من شح إمدادات الذاكرة حتى السنة المالية 2028، وإس كيه هاينكس تحذر من استمرار النقص حتى 2030.

stories.title: HBM4 prices to nearly triple in 2027, memory makers see windfall margins spread
stories.summary: Korean memory makers have quoted aggressive long-term HBM4 contract prices for 2027. The body is paywalled, and price figures are unverified.
bullets: Memory supply and demand will tighten further in 2027, and South Korean memory makers have recently quoted aggressive long-term contract prices for HBM4, according to supply chain sources
stories.lenovo: ISG: a near-tripling of HBM4 prices flows into 2027 GPU server pricing. HUMAIN-scale bids should carry GPU and HBM price-adjustment mechanisms.
stories.arabic: ديجيتايمز: توقع ارتفاع أسعار ذاكرة HBM4 بنحو ثلاثة أضعاف في 2027 مع تقديم المصنعين الكوريين عروض عقود طويلة الأجل بأسعار مرتفعة.

stories.title: Early October Panel Prices: MNT, NB Flat Despite Weak Demand as Component Costs Rise; TV Holds Steady
stories.summary: Notebook and monitor panel prices are flat in October despite weak demand. Notebook brand procurement is down more than 20% QoQ, and rising component costs block price cuts.
bullets: Notebook panel procurement by the top six brand customers is projected to decline more than 20% QoQ, yet NB panel prices are expected to remain flat in October
Monitor panel demand is projected to decline 8% QoQ in 4Q26, with MNT panel prices forecast flat
Rising upstream component costs are constraining price cuts across TV, monitor and notebook panels
stories.lenovo: IDG: no cost relief from panels to offset memory, so hold META PC pricing rather than discounting into the Q4 public-sector budget flush.
stories.arabic: تريندفورس: أسعار ألواح الحواسيب المحمولة والشاشات مستقرة في أكتوبر رغم ضعف الطلب وتراجع مشتريات كبرى العلامات بأكثر من 20% بسبب ارتفاع تكاليف المكونات.

opportunities.account: Aramco Digital – counter Dell industrial-AI MoU
opportunities.title: Table an ALAT-made industrial-AI and continuity offer at Aramco Digital before the Dell MoU becomes a programme
opportunities.why_now: Dell signed an exploratory MoU covering industrial AI, AI infrastructure, managed IT, cyber resilience and joint go-to-market through Dell channel partners. No value and no exclusivity stated.
opportunities.entry_point: Aramco Digital CEO office and infrastructure leads; Aramco IT procurement; CNTXT
opportunities.owner: ISG KSA energy account lead with RHQ executive sponsor

opportunities.account: HUMAIN–center3 Riyadh AI data centre (16.2 to 50 MW)
opportunities.title: Win the IT fit-out and a Neptune cooling design for the HUMAIN–center3 Riyadh halls
opportunities.why_now: The construction JV (Hassan Allam / Sterling & Wilson, estimated SR750m) was awarded. Four 11.2 MW high-density halls; MEP design being fixed now; IT vendor undisclosed.
opportunities.entry_point: center3 CTO and infrastructure; HUMAIN infrastructure procurement; the JV's MEP design team
opportunities.owner: ISG KSA HUMAIN account lead with stc/center3 account lead

opportunities.account: Salam – ThinkAgile HX under Salam–Nutanix private cloud
opportunities.title: Position Lenovo ThinkAgile HX as the hardware for Salam's Nutanix private-cloud service
opportunities.why_now: Three-year Salam–Nutanix managed private-cloud service for Saudi B2B. Salam already partners Dell; the Nutanix layer opens the hardware choice.
opportunities.entry_point: Salam CBO Abdullah Khorami's team; Nutanix KSA (Talal Al-Saif) as co-sell partner
opportunities.owner: ISG KSA channel lead with Nutanix alliance manager

opportunities.title: ALAT-made devices and edge for giga-project packages now favouring local content
opportunities.why_now: ROSHN sources about 60% locally and is splitting contracts into smaller packages; Qiddiya reports the same shift.
opportunities.entry_point: ROSHN procurement and IT; Qiddiya development and IT; local integrators bidding the smaller packages
opportunities.owner: IDG KSA public-sector/giga-project lead with government affairs
